application.port5173: Different project; never used or stopped

method.dom: Document client/scroll widths; visible non-scrollable element rectangles; leaf text client/scroll widths except intentional ellipsis; overlay content/button bounds against arena; hit testing and native clicks for reachable actions.
method.visual: Native screenshots plus direct visual inspection of representative mobile/dialog/game/creator/room states. Saved exact before/after evidence for real findings.
method.mainCss: src/main.css is not present; src/main.tsx imports styles.css,lobby.css,arcade-theme.css,creator.css.

findings.state: Local match result; winner nickname M repeated20 times; first victory unlock toast
findings.expected: Winner label and both result actions visible or reachable through a deliberate scroll area.
findings.actual: At landscape CSS width844 the desktop two-column result stays inside a265px-high arena. The winner eyebrow starts y-27.05 and the title y-2.05; Revancha is y329.05–372.05 and return action y385.05–406.05 below arena bottom322. The overflow:hidden arena clips title and both actions.
reproduction: Set both player nicknames to20 M characters
Dispatch actual keyboard handler KeyA down and hold ~7s to lose two stocks
findings.recommendation: Use content height/compact single-column result in short landscape or scrollable overlay; avoid negative centering when content exceeds arena.
findings.status: Fixed centrally. Final CSS independent real local match with20M winner+first-win unlock passed13 requested viewports plus901×900,667×375,812×375. At844×390 both result actions fit viewport without scrolling (rematch y270.8–313.8, return y320.8–341.8); document height423 includes controls below. Native return and rematch succeeded. Fullscreen actual DOM400×300 had scrollable overlay396×296 with both actions hit-test reachable; requested844×390 fullscreen could not be independently achieved due preview transport reset.

findings.status: Fixed centrally. Final pause CSS measured320/360/390/844 with no content outside arena; mobile arena min-height260 and compact landscape pause. Online longer explanation also fits; fullscreen native supported.

All9 stages; Vicente fighter detail, combos and selection button; help controls table/gamepad note; progress zero and3-match recent history; ranking/coming-soon; create/join validation and empty rooms; public room with long20-character host nickname.; full41-card La gente de la arena roster dialog measured in all13 requested viewports.

Signup form; signin form; actual invalid credential alert; authenticated tab-local fixture states ready/published/failed/drawing with existing sprite art;24-character account+fighter names; filled240-character description; actual native upload of3existingWebPfiles and remove2nd photo3→2/add icon; style/color form layouts and service-unavailable disabled generation action.

intentionalBehaviorsAndNotes: Intentional mobile/tablet .stage-strip horizontal scroll verified through layout and selecting stages; offscreen stage buttons are not document overflow.
Portrait/hero/fighter-card sprite crops, hidden1px creator file input, ellipsis for roster/HUD names, editable input horizontal text scrolling and textarea vertical scrolling are intentional.
Modal body vertical scrolling allows long detail/help/progress/stage/room content to remain reachable; no horizontal modal scroll is intended for room rows.
All measured documents had scrollWidth equal clientWidth; dialog-level room overflow was found despite document widths matching.
No canvas intrinsic1080×640 dimensions or data-attribute content treated as UI overflow.
Agent wrote no runtime/code/assets/packages, started no servers, did not use5173, did not spawn agents, and never operated parent/human tabs.
limitations: Viewport resizing used T3 native desktop Chromium; it changes CSS sizes but does not prove behavior on physical mobile devices, mobile keyboard opening, or coarse pointer emulation.

No live AI generation attempted because generation capability is disabled and API key is unconfigured. Authenticated creator ready/published/failed/drawing records are explicitly tab-local creatorApi fixtures using existing sprite assets; publishing/retrying/removing/creating were not invoked.
Real sign-in was exercised with a nonexistent review account and invalid password to inspect the error; no real signup account was created.
Creator empty-workbench/loading states were source-reviewed; authenticated populated fixtures and actual photo previews were renderer-tested.
The long-name creator card's before defect was reported by parent; this agent independently verified the correction after it was applied.
Initial long-name live-HUD and photo-filled batch sweeps had transient native-host errors and are excluded from valid coverage; both were subsequently measured successfully.

T3 fullscreen entry reset this agent's DOM viewport/screen to400×300 while screenshot capture retained requested844×390 sizing. Reapplying native viewport844×390 after entry and awaiting two animation frames still reported actual DOM/screen/arena400×300. Both result actions remained reachable via overlay scroll (scrollHeight325/clientHeight296). Parent reproduced the preview transport behavior and also obtained correct932×430 fullscreen in another execution. This agent verifies fullscreen behavior at actual400×300, not844×390.
